ben: seeing spikes of 500s on /batch-infer from canary host canary-2-7, sample traces show tokenizer OOM errors. attaching snippet:
```
2026-03-20T15:23:40Z ERROR inference.worker batch_request failed: TokenizerError: buffer overflow

```
micah: thanks — pulling canary and pausing rollout.
anya: pause acknowledged. pausing deploy now.
deploy-bot: Deploy paused by user @anya — reason: observed 500s on /batch-infer from canary (see logs). Traffic rolled back to 100% stable.
sre-lead: recommendation: pin model-serving image and tokenizer to previous working tags (`redwood/model-srv:1.12.2`, `redwood/tokenizer:3.4.1`) before retry. looks like tokenizer compatibility regression in v1.12.3.
micah: creating rollback/ops ticket and pinning traffic. ticket #4521 created: https://go/tickets/4521 — assigning to eng-runtime.
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by @micah — target tag: v1.12.2 | commit: d9e8ff1 | reason: canary 500s on /batch-infer. Estimated time: ~10m.
deploy-bot: Rollback progress: reverting canary hosts -> applying v1.12.2 image | pulling images and updating config.
deploy-bot: Rollback complete — status: SUCCESS | finished in 7m | traffic restored to 100% on prod | current prod tag: v1.12.2 :white_check_mark: | logs: https://go/deploy/logs/1798800123
anya: good catch team. I'll open a PR to pin tokenizer and add a compatibility test in the CI matrix.
pm-jordan: please add an impact summary to the release notes and schedule a short RCA tomorrow 11:00am. tagging infra and runtime leads.
sre-lead: follow-up actions added to ticket #4521: pin image tags, add tokenizer regression test, add canary config to run heavier batch-infer load.
deploy-bot: Final status: hotfix tag v1.12.3-hotfix remains unpromoted (aborted) — production running v1.12.2. Next steps: PR -> CI -> new canary attempt after fixes.
